headerDisplay: Control an Eliot sit-stand desk with the Smart Dongle from the Home app, over Bluetooth. Requires Linux — the plugin talks to BlueZ.
footerDisplay:
The dongle advertises under whatever name the desk has been given in the Eliot app, and carries no manufacturer name, so there is often nothing in a scan list to pick it out by. The scan above matches on the Bluetooth service it speaks instead, which is the same whatever it is called.

The desk appears as a window covering: 0% is the lowest height it is set to allow, 100% the highest. Those come from the desk's own limits, so changing them on the handset changes what 0% and 100% mean.

name.title: Name
name.description: Only the log prefix. Each desk is named separately below.

name.title: Name
name.description: What the desk is called in the Home app.

mac.title: Dongle address
mac.description: Bluetooth address of the Smart Dongle.

idlePollSeconds.title: Idle refresh (seconds)
idlePollSeconds.description: How often to ask a standing desk for its height, which is how the handset being used gets noticed. 0 turns it off; keep it in seconds, not milliseconds.

memorySwitches.title: Memory switches
memorySwitches.description: Offer the desk's memory positions as switches. Only positions the desk actually has appear.

childLockSwitch.title: Child lock as a switch
childLockSwitch.description: Offer the desk's child lock in the Home app. It is the one setting the control box reports back, so it is the one that can be shown honestly.

ecoMode.title: Eco mode

oneOf.title: Leave the desk as it is

ecoMode.description:
Eco mode and travel speed, set as a pair: about 22 mm/s against 42 mm/s.

Takes effect only after the desk is reset by hand — run it to the bottom and hold the down key until it re-homes. Until then it keeps its old speed, whatever this says.

collisionSensitivity.title: Anti-collision sensitivity

oneOf.title: High — stops at the slightest resistance

collisionSensitivity.description:
The control box's own obstruction detection, not this plugin's. On high, resting your arms on the desk is enough to stop a move a centimetre in and have it reported as stalled.

Reset the desk after changing this — run it to the bottom and hold the down key until it re-homes. Eco mode and travel speed share this settings block and only come into force at a reset; whether this one does too has not been measured, so if nothing changes, that is the thing to try.

autoMove.description: Move the desk between two heights on a timer. Adds an Auto Movement switch to the Home app, and nothing moves until you turn it on.

sittingMm.title: Sitting height (mm)
sittingMm.description: Clamped to the desk's own limits if it will not go that far.

standingMm.title: Standing height (mm)
standingMm.description: Must be above the sitting height.

intervalMinutes.title: Move every (minutes)
intervalMinutes.description: Must be longer than the warning.

warnMinutes.title: Warn before (minutes)
warnMinutes.description: A Desk Move Soon sensor trips this long before each move; turn on its notifications in the Home app to be told. 0 turns the warning off and removes the sensor.

windows.title: Working hours
windows.description: Outside these hours nothing moves and nothing warns.

switchOffDaily.title: Ask again each day
switchOffDaily.description: Switches Auto Movement off again at the end of each day, so it only runs on days you turn it on. Off means the switch stays on until you turn it off.

timerSlider.title: Timer slider
timerSlider.description: Adds a Timer slider showing how much of the interval is left before the next move. Drag it to put the move off or bring it forward; all the way down moves the desk now, without the warning. Off removes the slider.
